item_name: Rothco Deluxe U.S. Air Force Wing Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Show off your pride in the United States Air Force with Rothco's Deluxe U.S. Air Force Wing Low Profile Insignia Cap. Made from durable 100% brushed cotton twill, these low profile baseball caps are designed to withstand rigorous outdoor elements. These hats feature the iconic wing logo with raised embroidery on the front and "U.S. Air Force" text on the brim. The adjustable hook and loop closure ensures a perfect fit, while the padded sweatband adds extra comfort.
